Subject: KyraTech supplier onboarding — corrupted activation checksum

Hi Michael,

We received the invite to register in your supplier portal this morning but when we click the activation link we get an error page that says "checksum mismatch / invalid token" (screenshot attached). Tried in Chrome and Edge on Windows.

Could you reissue the invite or activate our account manually? We need to submit a W-9 and get a PO for the upcoming order this week.

- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Contact: Susan Park, AP Lead (susan.park@kyratech.com, +1 415-555-0192)

Subject: Re: KyraTech supplier onboarding — corrupted activation checksum

Susan — thanks for the report and sorry about the friction. I opened an internal ticket (SUP-4921) to investigate why some invites produce a checksum/validation failure.

For now two immediate options to unblock you:
1) Try the link in an incognito window (sometimes a stale cookie interferes).
2) If that still fails, Ben can send a DocuSign onboarding packet so you can complete the vendor form/W-9 outside the portal; we'll create a temporary supplier record and issue the PO.

Ben / Monica — can you reissue a short-lived invite token for KyraTech (TTL 24h) and also share the DocuSign fallback? Susan attached screenshots which may help debug.

I copied the minimal vendor info above into SUP-4921. I will follow up once we have a repro and timeline for a permanent fix.

— Michael Grant

michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133
